description: Interface depths (m) of GRIB soil-level indices (code table 4.5 type 151) per source mapping name; the layer between soil levels a and b spans interfaces_m[name][a] to interfaces_m[name][b].  A NetCDF mapping's soil selectors are variable names with no depth: its k-th selector is the layer from interfaces_m[name][k] to interfaces_m[name][k+1].

sources.ecmwf-open-data-ifs-oper-0p25-grib2-glob: IFS land surface (HTESSEL) soil layers 0-7, 7-28, 28-100 and 100-289 cm, IFS documentation Part IV, chapter 8
sources.ecmwf-era5-arco-netcdf-global-analysis: ERA5 (IFS cycle 41r2 HTESSEL) soil layers 0-7, 7-28, 28-100 and 100-289 cm: stl1-4 and swvl1-4, which the engine's ARCO bridge writes as ST000007/ST007028/ST028100/ST100289 and SM000007 ... SM100289
